title: Article 84 — Qualification for membership of Parliament

content.overview: Article 84 sets the qualifications for membership of Parliament: citizenship of India; oath or affirmation under the Third Schedule; minimum age — 30 years for the Council of States, 25 years for the House of the People; and such other qualifications as Parliament may by law prescribe.
content.glance: Citizen + Third Schedule oath + age (RS 30 / LS 25) + other qualifications prescribed by Parliament.
content.study:
Article 84:
A person shall not be qualified to be chosen to fill a seat in Parliament unless he—
(a) is a citizen of India, and makes and subscribes before some person authorised in that behalf by the Election Commission an oath or affirmation according to the form set out for the purpose in the Third Schedule;
(b) is, in the case of a seat in the Council of States, not less than thirty years of age and, in the case of a seat in the House of the People, not less than twenty-five years of age; and
(c) possesses such other qualifications as may be prescribed in that behalf by or under any law made by Parliament.

Disqualifications are separately provided in Article 102 and the Representation of the People Act.

Examination: citizenship; oath (Third Schedule); age differential RS/LS; residual parliamentary power to prescribe further qualifications.

sections.heading: Qualifications
sections.body:
1. Citizen of India.
2. Oath/affirmation (Third Schedule) before authorised person.
3. Age: ≥30 (Rajya Sabha); ≥25 (Lok Sabha).
4. Other qualifications as Parliament by law prescribes.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What are the qualifications for membership of Parliament under Article 84?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 84, a person must be a citizen of India, make and subscribe the Third Schedule oath or affirmation before a person authorised by the Election Commission, be at least 30 years of age for the Council of States or 25 for the House of the People, and possess such other qualifications as Parliament may by law prescribe.

examTips: Citizen + oath + age (30 RS / 25 LS) + other statutory qualifications.

keyTakeaways: Art 84: citizen, oath, age 30/25, other qualifications by law.
